BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 552,571 of its ordinary shares between July 6th and July 10th, 2026, with the intention of cancelling these shares. The highest price paid per share was 68.90 pence, and the lowest was 65.90 pence, with a volume-weighted average price of 67.49 pence across all transactions. Following these purchases, the company's issued ordinary share capital stands at 345,476,263 shares, with 3,867,640 shares held in treasury. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 13 July 2026 13 July 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. In aggregate, 3,867,640 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 341,608,623 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
